title: DefectRecord
description: Structural Telemetry paper v1.1 §6.1 / §10.8. measured_zero ≠ undefined_by_type ≠ skipped ≠ ill_conditioned. DimensionEvents (§6.9) are DefectRecords with defect_type = dimension_mismatch and before/after index maps in payload.

defect_type.description: e.g. noncommutativity | nonassociativity | grade_leakage | projection_loss | rotor_norm_defect | spectral_drift | eigenframe_drift | phase_drift | phase_slip | support_loss | dimension_mismatch | frame_mismatch

normalizer.description: denominator convention, e.g. norm(A)*norm(B)+eps; record eps explicitly

eps.description: regularizer used in the normalizer, if any

aggregation.description: required when a vector quantity (e.g. principal angles) is reported as a scalar; default max
